blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo transpor um trecho formal de discurso para um registro informal de blog, mantendo o sentido e ajustando vocabulário, sintaxe e tom.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: From Podium to Page: Making a Speech Sound Like Me
paras: The original line read: “**It is incumbent upon us to ensure** that all residents **have access to** adequate public services.” Fine for a hall; **stiff** for a blog. My version: “**We’ve got to make sure** everyone **can get** the basic services they need.” Same idea, **half the syllables**.

Other swaps: **commence → start**, **in the event that → if**, **a considerable number of → loads of**. I also **dropped the passive**, **added contractions**, and **tossed in** one rhetorical question (“**Isn’t that the least we can do?**”). Careful, though: **too casual** and you **lose authority**. **Aim for** warm, not sloppy.

items.q: The blogger keeps the formal sentence unchanged.
Contractions make the text more informal.
Too casual a tone can lose authority.

blocks.body: Para transpor, mude: **vocabulário** (latino → anglo-saxão), **sintaxe** (passiva → ativa), **forma** (contrações) e **marcadores** (*you know, well*). Mantenha o **sentido** e a **autoridade**.
*Loads of* e *tons of* são informais; evite-os em textos jurídicos ou acadêmicos.

Isn’t that the ___ we can do? (least)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Dumb down.** — Simplificar demais.
**Keep it real.** — Manter a autenticidade.
**Talk down to.** — Falar de cima para baixo.
**Cut the jargon.** — Cortar o jargão.
**In plain English.** — Em linguagem simples.
**Strike a chord.** — Tocar um ponto sensível.
**Loosen up.** — Descontrair.
**Come across as.** — Parecer, transmitir imagem de.
**Tone down.** — Suavizar.
**Put it bluntly.** — Dizer sem rodeios.
**Rewrite this: “It is incumbent upon us to ensure access.”** — Reescreva: “Cabe a nós garantir o acesso.”
**We’ve got to make sure everyone can get in.** — Temos que garantir que todos consigam entrar.
**Good. Is it too casual for the report?** — Bom. É informal demais para o relatório?

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.q: Explain when casual is a risk.
prompts.model: In a report, it can reduce authority.

blocks.task: Rewrite this formal sentence in an informal blog register and explain two changes: “It is imperative that residents be informed of any alterations to the schedule.”
blocks.model: We’ve got to let residents know if the schedule changes. I used a contraction and replaced the formal subjunctive with a simple modal. I also replaced “alterations” with “changes”, which is shorter and warmer.
